{model}: placeholder-only string: the model name is interpolated, nothing else to translate
{label}: {version}: label and version formatting, no prose
Cron {expression} ({zone}): a cron expression and a time zone, both literal
{m}/{d}: numeric date skeleton; the slash form is ordinary Japanese usage
,: thousands separator inside numbers, which Japanese also writes with a comma
OK: button label; Japanese UIs keep OK as a wordmark
ID: identifier label, written ID in Japanese technical UI
AGENT TEAMS: product eyebrow, kept as wordmark styling
DeepSeek Account: provider and account product name, kept in Latin script with the other provider names
Tarball: package format, kept in Latin script in Japanese developer UI
inherit-parent: sentinel value the user types or selects
